description: Vélib - Vélos et bornes - Disponibilité temps réel is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autolib Velib Métropole. Dataset showing the availability of terminal blocks, mechanical and electric bicycles at Vélib’ Métropole stations. For more information on the Vélib service’”). Vélib’ Métropole has nearly 1,400 stations in 55 municipalities in the Métropole and nearly 400 km ² serviced, is the largest shared bike service in the world, including rechargeable electric bikes in stations. Coverage: Autolib Velib Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Vélib - Bicycles and terminals - Real-time availability" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autolib Velib Métropole. Its keywords include velo, deplacements, deplacements-transports, velo-electrique, mobilite, 2-roues. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
